subject: Urgent: Demo time clash during DST transition — 3-zone cover needed
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@nimbustech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo next week — conflict with DST switchover

Hi Irene,

Quick heads up — our ops team just flagged a conflict for the demo slot on 2025-03-09. US daylight saving moves that week and a few of our APAC attendees will be affected (we switch later in March). With your original time (1400 PT) that puts EU participants outside normal hours. Can we move the slot or arrange a handoff so coverage is solid across US/EU/APAC?

We still want the full walkthrough + open Q&A; ideally avoid late-night for our Tokyo and Amsterdam folks. Attaching a short matrix of attendee timezones.

Thanks,
Alex
NimbusTech — Solutions Lead

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2025 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Demo next week — conflict with DST switchover

Folks — forwarding Alex's note. Nimbus is asking for either: (A) move the demo earlier to accommodate APAC/EU overlap or (B) split into two short blocks with a hosting handoff (US -> EU). We need to confirm who can take APAC or EU end.

Proposed quick options (local times in parentheses):
- Move 1400 PT -> 1100 PT (19:00 CET, 02:00 JST) — still rough for Tokyo
- Move to 1700 PT -> 14:00 ET (20:00 CET, 04:00 JST) — bad for APAC
- Two-block plan: 1100 PT 60m core demo (US/EU overlap), then 2200 PT 30m APAC wrap (led by APAC rep)

Can you tell me availability for those windows? Karthik — you good for leading the EU handoff if we do two-block? Marissa — can you support the APAC wrap or find a backup?

Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2025 11:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Demo next week — conflict with DST switchover

Irene — I can cover the EU handoff if we do the two-block approach. My availability: 1100 PT / 19:00 CET works for me for the core demo. I'm unfortunately blocked for any calls after 22:00 CET, so APAC wrap would need to be handled by Marissa or Sean.

If we prefer a single window, my preference is 1100 PT start so APAC has at least the beginning of the demo live and we can record the session for them.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2025 13:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Demo next week — conflict with DST switchover

Irene/Karthik — I can take the APAC wrap but prefer not to do it at 02:00 JST. Is there a possibility to split it into a 90-minute core + 30-minute deep-dive scheduled 18 hours later so APAC gets a reasonable local time (morning JST)? That would mean two separate invites but avoids middle-of-night.

Operationally:
- Core demo: 1100 PT / 19:00 CET — record and include Q&A for EU. (Karthik leading EU)
- APAC deep-dive: next-day 0900 JST (the morning after) — Marissa to run deep technical session for Asia-Pacific attendees.

If Nimbus prefers the demo all-in-one, we can offer 1100 PT and promise a recorded segment + synchronous follow-up with APAC engineer in their morning next day.

Marissa
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
